speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Everyone has a part to play to keep Singapore and Singaporeans safe.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: NSCS works with schools, businesses and people from all walks of life to raise public awareness of security issues and prepare them for potential threats and risks.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Now in its third year, the "Let's Stand Together" campaign has grown in following.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Members of the public engage actively in both online and offline activities to offer views and suggestions.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Many support greater civic consciousness and social responsibility to ensure Singapore's national security.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: NSCS will use the feedback and suggestions to shape the next phase of the "Let's Stand Together" campaign.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Social resilience is a key ingredient of national security.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: In the event of a crisis, it is not just the security agencies that will be called to respond.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Our society as a whole will also be tested.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We must ensure that we can bounce back from any incident and emerge stronger and more united.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singaporeans are already among the most networked and connected in the world.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: As we strive to become more integrated as a Smart Nation, we will become even more interconnected.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: While we can never be certain of where the next security threat may emerge, we need to prepare ourselves and develop robust plans that can be adapted for different threat scenarios.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Standing together, we stand a better chance of ensuring our national security.
